name: Chunk 2/24
text:
## Executive Summary  
FirstUK Bank retains customer and operational documents for periods mandated by law and business need, then destroys records securely to minimize data breach risk and compliance burden.  
---

name: Chunk 3/24
text:
## Purpose & Scope  
### Purpose  
To establish retention schedules that:
- Comply with legal and regulatory obligations
- Support dispute resolution and audits
- Minimize data retention risk (GDPR: data minimization)
- Ensure secure destruction
- Maintain audit trail

name: Chunk 4/24
text:
### Scope  
Applies to:
- All customer documents
- All transaction records
- All policy/procedure documentation
- All audit and compliance files
- All physical and digital records  
---

name: Chunk 5/24
text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank retains documents only as long as legally required or business-justified, then destroys them securely.**  
---

name: Chunk 6/24
text:
## Retention Schedule by Document Type  
### Customer & Account Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Legal Basis | Destruction Method |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Customer Profile** | Account tenure + 6 years | POCA, AML, dispute | Shred/delete |
| **KYC/CDD Records** | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs 2017 | Shred/delete |
| **Identification Docs** | 6 years post-closure | POCA, anti-fraud | Shred/delete |
| **Address Verification** | 6 years post-closure | KYC requirements | Shred/delete |
| **Account Opening Forms** | 6 years post-closure | Contract evidence | Shred/delete |
| **Statements** | Account tenure + 6 years | Customer service, disputes | Shred/delete |
| **Transaction Records** | 6 years minimum | POCA, audit, disputes | Shred/delete |
| **Standing Orders** | Account tenure + 2 years | Contract evidence | Delete |
| **Direct Debit Mandates** | 6 years post-cancellation | DD scheme rules | Shred/delete |

name: Chunk 7/24
text:
### Compliance & Regulatory Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Legal Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **Complaint Files** | 6 years from resolution | FCA COBS Part 2 |
| **Regulatory Reports** | 5 years | PRA Rulebook, audit |
| **AML Screening Results** | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs |
| **SAR (Suspicious Activity)** | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act |
| **Audit Reports** | 7 years | Statutory audit |
| **Board/Committee Minutes** | Permanent | Corporate governance |
| **Compliance Bulletins** | 3 years | Regulatory reference |
| **Regulatory Circulars** | 3–5 years | Regulatory guidance |

name: Chunk 8/24
text:
### Operational & Support Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **SOPs & Procedures** | Current + 2 prior versions | Governance, audit trail |
| **Policy Documents** | Permanent (all versions) | Governance, legal |
| **Training Records** | 3 years | Compliance training verification |

| **System Access Logs** | 1 year | Security, audit |
| **Backup Tapes** | 30 days (rotating) | Disaster recovery |
| **Email (general)** | 1–3 years | Business efficiency |
| **Email (legal/compliance)** | 7 years | Legal hold |

name: Chunk 11/24
text:
## Extended Retention  
**Retention Extended If:**
- Customer dispute is active (until resolution + 6 years)
- Regulatory investigation ongoing (until conclusion)
- Legal action pending (until conclusion + 6 years)
- Customer requests retention (must be documented)
- Regulatory requirement (GDPR, POCA, etc.)  
**Process:**
1. Document placed on legal hold
2. Marked "Do Not Destroy"
3. Reassess annually
4. Destroy when hold lifted  
---

name: Chunk 12/24
text:
## Early Destruction  
**Some documents destroyed early if:**  
**Email (non-compliance):**
- Routine operational emails: 1 year
- Archived to external storage: 3 years
- Compliance emails: 7 years (legal hold)  
**System Logs:**
- General transaction logs: 1 year
- Archived for backup: 30 days
- Compliance/audit logs: 1 year minimum  
**Process:**
1. Categorize document
2. Confirm no legal hold
3. Schedule for destruction
4. Destroy securely
5. Confirm and document  
---

name: Chunk 13/24
text:
## Destruction Methods  
### Physical Documents  
**Shredding:**
- On-site shredder (if <10 pages/day)
- Shred before recycle
- Document destruction log  
**Professional Shredding:**
- Third-party secure destruction company
- Certificate of destruction provided
- Scheduled pickup (monthly/quarterly)
- Chain of custody maintained

name: Chunk 14/24
text:
### Digital Records  
**Secure Deletion:**
- Data overwriting (DoD standard, 3-pass)
- Encrypted deletion (AES-256)
- Physical destruction (hard drives)  
**Process:**
1. Identify files to destroy
2. Quarantine to destruction folder
3. Secure delete (not just recycle bin)
4. Verify deletion
5. Certificate generated  
---

name: Chunk 15/24
text:
## Records Management System  
**Digital Retention Tracking:**  
- Document storage system (DMS-001) tracks retention dates
- Automated alerts 30 days before destruction
- Destruction log records all deletions
- Audit trail maintained  
---

name: Chunk 16/24
text:
## Customer Requests  
**Customer Right to Data Deletion:**  
**GDPR Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"):**
- Customer can request deletion
- FirstUK Bank may refuse if legal obligation exists
- Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)  
**Procedure:**
1. Customer requests deletion (in writing)
2. FirstUK Bank assesses legal hold
3. If no hold: Destroy and confirm
4. If hold: Explain reason and timeframe  
---

name: Chunk 17/24
text:
## Dispute & Legal Holds  
**Litigation Hold:**
- Customer dispute or legal action
- Retain all relevant documents
- Document marked "Legal Hold"
- Cannot destroy during dispute
- Destroy 6 years after resolution  
**Regulatory Investigation:**
- Regulator requests hold
- Retain all specified documents
- Follow regulator timeline
- Destroy per regulator instruction  
---

name: Chunk 18/24
text:
## Audit & Compliance  
**Records Audit:**
- Annual audit of retention practices
- Sample file review (destruction logs)
- Compliance with retention schedule
- Unauthorized destruction assessment  
**Regulatory Audit:**
- FCA/PRA periodic reviews
- Document retention sampling
- POCA compliance assessment  
---

name: Chunk 19/24
text:
## Staff Responsibilities  
### Document Owners  
- Know retention period for documents
- Comply with destruction schedule
- Flag legal holds
- Document customer requests

name: Chunk 20/24
text:
### Compliance/Records  
- Maintain retention schedule
- Monitor destruction
- Verify compliance
- Audit records management  
---

name: Chunk 21/24
text:
## Training & Awareness  
**Mandatory Annual Training:**
- All staff: Document retention awareness (30 min)
- Managers: Retention responsibility (60 min)
- Compliance: Advanced retention governance (2 hours)  
---
